codes.name: C
codes.description: Record coming over is a correction and thus replaces a final result

codes.name: F
codes.description: Final results;  Can only be changed with a corrected result.

codes.name: U
codes.description: Results status change to Final.  Results did not change (don't transmit test).  E.g., radiology changes status from preliminary to final

codes.name: X
codes.description: Results cannot be obtained for this observation
